description: Turn Q&A pairs into valid FAQPage JSON-LD schema markup.

faqs.a: Add questions and answers one by one, then click Generate — the tool builds a valid FAQPage JSON-LD block.
faqs.q: How do I generate FAQ schema?

faqs.a: Google shows a maximum of a few FAQs as rich results; keep questions genuinely helpful and matching visible page content.
faqs.q: How many FAQs should I include?

faqs.a: Yes — Google requires the questions and answers to be visible on the page for FAQ rich results eligibility.
faqs.q: Must the FAQs appear on the page?

faqs.a: Click Copy JSON-LD and paste the block inside your page's <head> or before </body>.
faqs.q: How do I add it to my site?

howto: Type a question and its answer.
Click Add Q&A — repeat for each pair.
Click Generate Schema to build the JSON-LD.
Copy or download it and paste into your page.
title: FAQ Schema Generator
